name: NetBird-Server
description: Combined NetBird server — management, signal, relay, and STUN in a single container for self-hosted VPN mesh networking. Requires a config.yaml and a reverse proxy for TLS.

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Directory containing config.yaml — generated by NetBird's getting-started.sh script, then placed here

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent data (SQLite DB, encryption keys, state)

ports.name: HTTP/gRPC Port
ports.description: HTTP/gRPC API port (reverse proxy targets this)

ports.name: STUN Port
ports.description: STUN UDP port for NAT traversal
